text: inside of the iso3d world editor in hmsc-int there are props. but the props are just rendering as basic blocks, and not the actual prop. can u solve that problem. for instance the dumpster/garbage is just a small block
resolution: Fixed hmsc-int build props so placed prop catalog rows render through the canonical hmsc Prop component instead of the generic build-piece box path. Compiled/no-V8 geometry now bakes prop rows through prop-aware multi-part geometry, including a recognizable dumpster, with fallback sizing still coming from the prop registry. Verified with tools/rjit game verify, hmsc-int cart bundle, and git diff --check.
